description: Fault actions used by `python3 -m relcoord.demo`. Counters make packet/receipt loss finite so retries recover automatically.
notes: drop_apply loses one publish instruction; the coordinator retries the same command id.
lose_receipt durably applies config but closes the first HTTP response.
The retry is observed as a duplicate command and does not append another config history entry.
Stopped services simulate loss of contact; restarting them replays persisted state.
